main_business: The company helps users find suitable rental apartments and homes to buy in Tokyo and nearby areas. Staff members answer customer questions, compare neighborhoods, explain area characteristics, and recommend candidate areas and properties based on budget, commute, lifestyle, family structure, and preferences.
workflows: Customers submit requirements through email or web forms. Real estate consultants manually read the requirements, search area information and property listings, compare neighborhoods, explain trade-offs, and recommend areas or properties. New staff often need time to learn neighborhood characteristics and property matching logic.

The company helps users find suitable rental apartments and homes to buy in Tokyo and nearby areas. Staff members answer customer questions, compare neighborhoods, explain area characteristics, and recommend candidate areas and properties based on budget, commute, lifestyle, family structure, and preferences.
pain_points: customer requirements are diverse and time-consuming to analyze
area information is scattered across different sources
consultants spend a lot of time comparing neighborhoods manually
recommendations may be inconsistent across staff members
foreign customers may need explanations in clear English or Japanese
users often do not know which area fits their budget and lifestyle
constraints: the system must not guarantee property price appreciation
the system must not make legal or financial decisions
final recommendation should be reviewed by a human real estate consultant
the system should explain reasoning and uncertainty clearly
ai_objective: Build an AI-enabled agent system that helps consultants analyze customer preferences and recommend suitable areas or property search directions.
consulting_agent_summary: The consulting agent looks for bounded AI enablement opportunities where local evidence, deterministic tools, LLM drafting, and human approval can improve a real workflow without full automation.
